name: Maou-sama wa Otoko no Ko!
source:
"I've found you, HEROOO!"
"Yes?"
"Take responsibility for what you've done to me!"
"What's this, now?"

In the middle of my college studies, the words abruptly crashed in. I listened to this girlishly dressed boy yell his problems at me. He (she?) was a crossdresser from a parallel world, apparently. The evil ruler of that world, apparently. But the hero from that world destroyed his (her?) castle, apparently.

"Wait wait wait, you're saying I'm that hero?" I said. "Look. I have NO legendary bloodline, I had NO dormant powers waiting to be unleashed by fate. I had no dead lover or whatever, to give me strength to fight. I'm a normal guy."

"No you're not! And on top of destroying my castle, you did THIS to me!"

When the parallel world hero defeated the girlishly dressed boy, he cursed him (her?) to into being male, and to never grow older... apparently. 

"You made it so I can never be anyone's bride! Take responsibility!"
"....... Sure."
"....... Huh?"

And from that one-way exchange, my sex life with a crossdressed ex-girl demon king began.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE110546.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“我找到你了，勇者——！”

“什么？”

“你要为对我做过的事负责！”

“这又是怎么回事？”

我在上大学时，这些话突然闯入耳中。我听着这个穿着女孩服装的男孩向我大声诉说自己的遭遇。他似乎来自平行世界，是那个世界的魔王。但那个世界的勇者似乎摧毁了他的城堡。

“等等，你说我是那个勇者？”我说，“听着，我没有什么传奇血统，也没有等待命运唤醒的沉睡力量。我没有死去的恋人可以给我战斗的力量。我就是一个普通人。”

“你才不是！而且，你毁了我的城堡，还对我做了这种事！”

当平行世界的勇者击败这个穿着女孩服装的男孩时，还诅咒他变成男性，永远不会长大……大概就是这样。

“你让我永远不可能成为任何人的新娘！你要负责！”

“……好吧。”

“……啊？”

就这样，我和这个女装的前任女魔王开始了单方面的性生活。
